defect_summary: Prep surfaces were written with nlc_release_prep_surfaces.py --write before planner WRITE_RECORD, then ./release stalled BLOCKED_WRITE_RECORD_STALLED.
unsuitable_process: Candidate FINDINGS/DESCRIBE/hub-release-record.json writes are allowed outside planner PREP/WRITE_RECORD. ADR 0049 treats an unchanged repair fact tuple as BLOCKED_<ACTION>_STALLED, so a side-channel write makes WRITE_RECORD a no-op.
climb_steps: WRITE_RECORD progress facts could not change.
ADR 0049: repairs that do not move their fact tuple stall.

repo_touch.belief: ADR 0025 — defects name unsuitable process, not agents
